row.evidence: Apollo's help centre says SCIM works with Okta and Microsoft Entra ID "when SAML single sign-on is active", and the pricing page lists Single Sign-on (SSO) under Organization ($119 per seat per month, min 3 seats, billed annually).
row.notes: New row (slug 'apollo' is Apollo.io, the sales-intelligence platform; the Okta OIN 'Apollo.io' app is SAML + SCIM, while a separate OIN 'Apollo' app is SWA only; Apollo GraphQL is a different company). SCIM needs an active SAML SSO connection with Okta or Entra (not Google/Microsoft OAuth sign-in), and the pricing cards put SSO on Organization, so the SCIM plan is inferred from that prerequisite (confidence medium); the pricing FAQ instead says SSO is for Custom plans (see conflicts). Team plan Basic $49, Professional $79, Organization $119 per seat/mo billed annually, min 3 seats; multiplier 119/49. SCIM syncs userName, givenName, familyName and active; no Groups, no team or permission-profile assignment, primary email never updated; deactivation keeps data and the seat can be reassigned; provisioning respects seat limits. The REST API is read-only for users (list users, current user profile); API access 'depends on your Apollo plan' and the rate-limit table includes Free.

auth.token_source: Settings > Security > Single sign-on > User Auto Provisioning (SCIM connector base URL and SCIM Token)

operations.notes: SCIM remove operations are ignored. Entra may deprovision by inactive status or by deleting the user; what Apollo does on DELETE is not stated.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivation does not delete the user's data or assets; the seat can be assigned to a new user.

attributes.notes: userName (primary email) is used to create users and is never updated by SCIM.

roles.notes: New SCIM users get the workspace's non-admin permissions; teams and permission profiles are not assigned.

limitations.text: Requires an active SAML SSO connection with Okta or Entra; not available with Google or Microsoft OAuth sign-in.
No /Groups resource; remove operations ignored; removing a user from a group alone doesn't deactivate them.
SCIM never changes a user's primary email.
Seat limits apply: if no seat is free the user is not provisioned or reactivated.
Users who belong to another Apollo workspace get an invitation instead of being created.
Deactivation is blocked for the workspace's last active admin.

endpoints.purpose: List users in the Apollo account (IDs)
Get the API key owner's profile

rate_limits.text: Per team and per endpoint; general limits Free 50/min, 200/h, 600/day; Basic and Professional 200/min, 400/h, 2,000/day; Organization 200/min, 600/h, 6,000/day.

limitations.text: No documented endpoints to create, update or deactivate users.

okta.notes: OIN 'Apollo.io' page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup). A separate OIN 'Apollo' app is SWA only.

entra.notes: Apollo's guide adds an enterprise app named Apollo.io and sets SAML and automatic provisioning with the SCIM URL and token; no gallery listing was confirmed.

google.notes: Google sign-in is OAuth only; SCIM is not available with it.
